mapper.sql: t.id, t.title, t.due_date, t.due_time, t.repeat_daily, t.note, t.done, t.done_at, t.done_by, t.request_id, t.request_hash, t.version, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, t.del_flag
mapper.select: select from preg_todo t where t.id = #{id} and t.del_flag = '0'
select from preg_todo t where t.request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into preg_todo ( title, due_date, due_time, repeat_daily, note, done, request_id, request_hash, version, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{title}, #{dueDate}, #{dueTime}, #{repeatDaily}, #{note}, #{done}, #{requestId}, #{requestHash}, 1, #{createBy}, now(3) )

insert into preg_todo (title, due_date, checkup_id, checkup_occurrence_date, create_by, create_time) values
(left(concat('安排产检 · ', #{title}), 200), #{date}, #{checkupId}, #{date}, 'system', now(3))
on duplicate key update version = if(del_flag = '3', version + 1, version), del_flag = if(del_flag = '3', '0', del_flag)
mapper.update: update preg_todo set title = #{title}, due_date = #{dueDate}, due_time = #{dueTime}, repeat_daily = #{repeatDaily}, note = #{note}, done = #{done}, done_at = #{doneAt}, done_by = #{doneBy}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'
update preg_todo set del_flag = '2', version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select from preg_todo t where t.due_date = #{dueDate} and t.del_flag = '0' order by t.done asc, t.due_time asc, t.id asc
